# GodlyWatch

> GodlyWatch tracks live values and prices for Roblox trading games — Murder Mystery 2 (MM2), Adopt Me, and Grow a Garden. Covers MM2 Godlies, Ancients, Chromas, and Sets; Adopt Me pets and vehicles; and Grow a Garden pets, crops, gears, and eggs. It also offers a trade checker, an inventory value tracker, and a marketplace of real MM2 items for sale.

## Pages

- [MM2 Board](https://godlywatch.com/mm2/board): Live values and eBay prices for MM2 Godly, Ancient, Chroma, and Set items, with 7-day price trend charts and demand/rarity ratings.
- [MM2 Marketplace](https://godlywatch.com/mm2/marketplace): Real MM2 items for sale on eBay at competitive prices, with Robux-equivalent pricing shown.
- [Adopt Me Board](https://godlywatch.com/adoptme/board): Live pet and vehicle values across Legendary, Ultra-Rare, Rare, Uncommon, and Common tiers.
- [Grow a Garden Board](https://godlywatch.com/growagarden/board): Live pet, crop, gear, and egg values sourced from traderie.com.
- [MM2 Trade Checker](https://godlywatch.com/mm2/trade-checker): Compare two MM2 trade offers side by side using live values.
- [Adopt Me Trade Checker](https://godlywatch.com/adoptme/trade-checker): Compare two Adopt Me trade offers side by side using live values.
- [Grow a Garden Trade Checker](https://godlywatch.com/growagarden/trade-checker): Compare two Grow a Garden trade offers side by side using live values.
- [MM2 Inventory Tracker](https://godlywatch.com/mm2/inventory): Track the total value of an MM2 inventory over time.
- [Adopt Me Inventory Tracker](https://godlywatch.com/adoptme/inventory): Track the total value of an Adopt Me inventory over time.
- [Grow a Garden Inventory Tracker](https://godlywatch.com/growagarden/inventory): Track the total value of a Grow a Garden inventory over time.

## Games tracked

- MM2 (Murder Mystery 2): Godly, Ancient, Chroma, and Set values sourced from supremevalues.com; eBay prices refreshed automatically.
- Adopt Me: Pet and vehicle values across Legendary, Ultra-Rare, Rare, Uncommon, and Common tiers, with Fly/Ride/Neon/Mega variant support.
- Grow a Garden: Pet, crop, gear, and egg values sourced from traderie.com, across Mythical, Legendary, Rare, Uncommon, and Common tiers.

## Notes

- Item categories: Godly, Ancient, Chroma, Sets (MM2); Pets, Vehicles (Adopt Me); Pets, Crops, Gears, Eggs (Grow a Garden)
- MM2 prices shown in EUR with an approximate Robux equivalent; eBay prices refreshed automatically
